name: module-marketplace
extends: Hermes: community marketplace for module discovery, packaging, and publishing (Phase 4)
description: Enables module sharing via a local registry: validates manifests, packages modules into .tar.gz with sha256 content hash, supports search by name/tag/description. Integrates with Jane OS CLI (publish/search subcommands).
install: Copy module files to Jane install dir; CLI gains 'publish' and 'search' subcommands
uninstall: Remove module files; CLI reverts to base commands
